rules.question: What text is a decimal number in a hand-edited file?
must_match: try { d = std::stod(v, &used); } catch (...) { bad(path, key, v, "a number"); }
rules.note: std::stod is the C runtime's strtod, which also reads nan, inf and hex floats; M73 found hydra_rules.ini taking those through it. Number readers with their own documented question (command-line arguments, .obj files, the chart-number rule in parse/song.cpp) use other spellings and are not this row's question. Decided by: D114 item 8 (M73, concept audit 2026-10-11)

rules.question: What text is a number of seconds in a GUI test command (timeout, wait)?
rules.decision: ADR 0030: timeout and wait take a finite number and nothing else, read as every Hydra number is (D114 item 8)
must_match: const auto [end, ec] = std::from_chars(first, last, v);
rules.note: The test interpreter once had its own from_chars number reader for timeout and wait. A test or tool under tests/ that reads a number from text calls parse_finite_number and adds its own range check after it.
